text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The strongest "White Lightning" conquers 
the Arima Kinen. Awed by such 
magnificence, Oguri Cap truly and deeply 
wishes from the bottom of her heart for 
her not to retire.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her body, having endured fierce battles, 
can still run much more. With the 
Trainer's support, she has been reborn.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Ah can't be leavin' things to the next 
generation just yet!" Tamamo Cross 
declared that she would keep leading the 
Twinkle Series next year and beyond.
